scope: Two complete recursive Git trees at pinned commits; current file bytes, not compressed transfers or Git history. No simulation reruns.
method: Group every nonempty blob from both trees by Git blob SHA; excess bytes are (number of paths - 1) times blob size. Git already deduplicates identical objects within each repository. Differently packaged numerical duplicates are outside this test.

navigation.source_bytes: Every read Markdown file verified against its pinned Git blob SHA.
navigation.limits: External URLs, all HTML links and all heading fragments were not exhaustively checked.

disposition: Historical evidence, null controls, recovery records, archive parts and study manifests preserved. Only current navigation/review documents and this inventory change.
